examples.en: I was told to book the plane ticket early.
I reserved a restaurant for the weekend.
I'm looking online to book a hotel.
You can book the hospital by phone.

examples.ko: 미리 예약하지 않으면 자리가 없을 거예요.
examples.en: If you don't reserve ahead, there won't be a seat.

explain: '(무엇)을 예약하다'로 써요. 영화나 공연, 기차표처럼 표를 미리 사는 것은 '예매하다'를 더 많이 써요. 예약을 없앨 때는 '예약을 취소하다'라고 해요.

phrases.example: 저녁 여섯 시에 자리를 예약해 주세요.
phrases.en: Please reserve a table for 6 p.m.
phrases.nuance_ko: 다른 사람에게 예약을 부탁할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to ask someone to make a reservation.

phrases.en: I booked the hotel in advance before the trip.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 미리 makes it clear you booked ahead of time.

phrases.en: Something came up, so I canceled the reservation.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you cancel a reservation.

explain_en: Use it as '(something)을 예약하다'. For buying tickets in advance, such as for movies, shows or trains, '예매하다' is more common. To cancel, say '예약을 취소하다'.
